nom: FARMACY Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several report it cleanses without tightness or added dryness and recommend it for dry skin; however, a notable number of other reviewers, including some who don't specify dry skin but describe a tight or dried-out feeling afterward, found it drying, especially in winter or with regular use, and one stopped using it for this reason.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report it balances oil in the T-zone while keeping drier areas comfortable, without leaving either area feeling stripped or tight.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, redness, or dryness, with some specifically noting it as gentle even for reactive or redness-prone skin; however, one reviewer had an immediate, severe burning reaction, another found it too fragranced and drying for her sensitive skin and repurposed it as a body wash, and one mentions it didn't work for her sister's more severely sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers describe the cleanser as hydrating or at least non-drying, saying it never leaves skin feeling tight, stripped, or squeaky, and several specifically contrast it with other cleansers that do dry them out. A meaningful minority, however, report it left their skin feeling tight or mildly dry, especially in winter, and one stopped using it for that reason.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some who describe redness-prone skin, report the cleanser did not trigger redness and, with continued use, even left their skin looking less red and inflamed.
concerns.barrier: The vast majority of reviewers, including many with sensitive skin, report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts even with daily use; however, one reviewer had an immediate, severe burning reaction and stopped use right away, and another found it too irritating for her sensitive skin due to the fragrance.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts and say it doesn't worsen existing blemishes; one reviewer, however, noticed more blemishes than usual and suspects it may not suit acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin consistently report it controls excess oil and keeps the T-zone balanced without over-drying other areas.

aspects.libelle: Light, spa-like scent, generally well liked
Pump dispenser with travel-friendly locking cap
Dispenser can stick or arrive faulty
Rich lather from a lightweight gel
A little goes a long way, bottle lasts
Higher price point for the brand

extraits.titre: Do not use this if you have sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I bought this hoping for a slightly deeper clean than the gentle care (my usual holy grail) it immediately burned the crap out of my skin like BADLY it hurts and im so disappointed I have never not loved a farmacy product but honestly I don't know why this needed to exist it doesn't seem much different from the regular green other than that it burns like acid. The only thing I do like is the bottle. Please put the gentle green in this 🙏.

I always love Farmacy packaging, and this one is no exception. This is a beautiful minimalist bottle which will look nice on your counter. This smells like something you might find at a spa and lathers nicely. I found that this did dry my skin out, so I will not continue to use it.

extraits.titre: Solid cleanser, not for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I'm giving it 4 starts because although it is a nice gel cleanser, it's too fragranced for my sensitive skin. This is true for most Farmacy products for my skin type. It did dry out my face a bit but i repurposed it for a body wash and it was perfect!

I needed some time to see how I liked it. And I can stay that I LOVE THIS CLEANSER. Leaves my skin nice moisturized and honestly it has been looking a lot less inflamed and less red. I have sensitive skin and it seemed to do well with mine. However my sister has overly sensitive skin and it did not work for her

I love Farmacy products and this one is no different! I have combination skin (T-zone is oily, everywhere else dry) and it is hard finding a face cleanser that is just right- cleans oily pores but doesn't strip the skin. It cleanses well, but it doesn't dry out my skin. It's gentle and it's pretty good at removing makeup and sunscreen. It smells pleasantly tropical but the scent isn't overpowering. It's a good size and I LOVE that it has a pump! Most of the mid to high end cleansers I've tried are squeeze tubes, so this is a really nice feature. A little goes a long way, but once I'm (eventually) out I'd definitely consider repurchasing :)

extraits.titre: Wonderful cleanser with a delicious smell!
extraits.texte: I have been using this product for about 3 weeks now, morning and night and it is amazing. It smells so refreshing and leaves my face feeling clean without being dried out. I have sensitive skin and this has not irritated it - in fact, I have noticed an overall improvement since beginning its use. My skin feels more hydrated and less red. I highly recommend giving this a shot.

extraits.titre: My face is so clean and moisturized!
extraits.texte: As a dry skin girlie who uses many actives, I needed a product that would cleanse the skin without being stripping. The ultimate goal was for my cleanser to do some of the heavy lifting when it came down to moisture. This product has given me that by never leaving my fact tight or dry. My face always feels moisturized which makes me believe that the next steps in my skincare regimen will follow suit and give me the moisture I need for the remainder of the day.
